 Korean Festival 2026 at Pacific Mall Delhi: Dates, Free Passes, K-Beauty Stalls & Ultimate Insider Guide 
 November 5, 2026 
 Tanusha Narula 
 Pacific Mall in Tagore Garden is turning into the ultimate epicenter for Hallyu enthusiasts across Delhi-NCR as Korea Culture Day / Korean Festival 2026 takes over West Delhi from 13 November to 22 November 2026. Spanning ten action-packed days, this massive cultural pop-up brings authentic Korean street food, steep discounts on viral K-Beauty skincare, live music, and exclusive K-pop merchandise under one roof—all with completely free admission.
 Whether you are a seasoned K-drama fanatic craving genuine tteokbokki or looking for incredible deals on glass-skin essentials, this complete survival guide breaks down everything you need to know before visiting.
 What is Korean Festival 2026 at Pacific Mall?
 The Korean Festival 2026 (also celebrated under the Korea Culture Day umbrella) is a ten-day immersive cultural fair designed to offer an authentic taste of Seoul in the heart of West Delhi. Unlike single-day conventions, this multi-day event converts the sprawling atrium of Pacific Mall, Tagore Garden, into a vibrant Korean night market and cultural experience zone.
 Visitors can explore interactive pop-up shopping stalls featuring trending Korean skincare brands, rare K-pop albums, photo booths, and authentic food stalls serving hot, fresh street delicacies prepared by Korean chefs and local artisanal vendors.
 Key Event Details at a Glance
 Parameter Event Detail 
 Event Name Korea Culture Day / Korean Festival 2026 (K-Food Universe) 
 Dates 13 November – 22 November 2026 
 Timings 11:00 AM – 9:30 PM Daily 
 Venue Main Atrium & Outdoor Plaza, Pacific Mall, Tagore Garden, New Delhi 
 Entry Fee Free Entry (No Pass Required) 
 Nearest Metro Tagore Garden Metro Station (Blue Line) 
 Best Time to Visit 12:30 PM – 3:30 PM (Weekdays for low crowds) 
 Key Highlights K-Beauty discounts, K-Pop merch, authentic street food, live music & photo zones 
 What to Expect: 4 Major Festival Zones
 1. K-Beauty & Skincare Pop-Up Paradise
 If your skincare goal is achieving that iconic “glass skin” glow, the K-Beauty pop-ups at this year’s festival are an unmissable destination. Leading Korean beauty distributors and local importers are setting up experiential booths featuring viral serums, sunscreen sticks, sheet mask bundles, and rice water cleansers. Many stalls offer live product testing, personalized skin shade matching, and buy-one-get-one discounts rarely available online.
 2. Korean Street Food (K-Food Alley)
 Food is the beating heart of the event. Expect live cooking stations serving classic street foods straight out of your favorite K-dramas. Highlights include:
 Cheesy Corn Dogs & Gamja Dogs: Crispy battered hot dogs wrapped in potatoes and mozzarella.
 Tteokbokki: Chewy rice cakes slathered in spicy-sweet gochujang sauce.
 Kimchi Fried Rice & Gimbap: Freshly rolled seaweed rice rolls packed with pickled radish and fillings.
 Bung-eo-ppang: Fish-shaped pastry filled with sweet red bean or creamy custard.
 Korean Fried Chicken (Dakgangjeong): Crunchy, double-fried chicken tossed in honey-garlic or spicy glaze.
 3. K-Pop Merchandise & Photobooths
 From official photocards, lightsticks, and posters to custom-printed hoodies and tote bags, fans of BTS, Stray Kids, BLACKPINK, and NewJeans will find dedicated merchandise stalls. Self-photo booths with Korean-style aesthetic frames and accessories (headbands, oversized glasses) are set up across the venue for memorable quick snaps with friends.
 4. Cultural Exhibits & Random Play Dance
 Throughout the ten days, expect spontaneous K-pop “Random Play Dance” challenges where fans gather to dance in sync to the latest hits. Keep an eye out for Hanbok (traditional Korean dress) try-on corners and mini language/calligraphy workshop booths operating on select weekend hours.
 Free Passes, Tickets, and Registration
 Do you need a ticket? No. Entry to the Korean Festival 2026 at Pacific Mall, Tagore Garden, is 100% free of charge . There are no paid ticket tiers or registration paywalls required to enter the mall atrium and explore the festival stalls. 
 Pro-Tip on Free Samples & Free Food: While the entry is free, food items and merchandise are paid. However, several K-Beauty stalls distribute free product samples, foil packets, and sheet masks upon completing simple social media check-ins or quiz games. Arrive early in the day as brand promotional samples are distributed on a first-come, first-served basis.
 If you are looking for more budget-friendly weekend activities across the capital, explore our curated list of free events in Delhi NCR .
 Recommended Dress Code
 There is no strict mandatory dress code, but to match the aesthetic and comfort of the event:
 Streetwear & K-Style Fashion: Oversized blazers, pleated skirts, wide-leg denim, neutral tones, or pastel aesthetic outfits blend in perfectly with the vibe.
 Comfortable Footwear: You will be standing and walking between stalls for hours. Opt for comfortable sneakers or flats rather than heels.
 K-Pop Merch: Wearing your favorite band’s hoodie or tour tee is a great conversation starter with fellow fans!
 How to Reach Pacific Mall, Tagore Garden
 Pacific Mall is one of West Delhi’s most accessible shopping hubs.
 By Metro (Recommended)
 Nearest Station: Tagore Garden Metro Station on the Blue Line .
 Directions: Take Exit Gate No. 1 or 2. The mall is located roughly 300 meters from the station. You can walk it in under 5 minutes or take an auto-rickshaw.
 By Road / Cab
 Set your GPS destination to Pacific Mall, Tagore Garden, Najafgarh Road .
 The mall sits right on the main Najafgarh Road, making it easily accessible via cab aggregators or personal vehicles. If you prefer safe late-night female-only transport back home, check out services like Fery Rides Gurugram and Delhi .
 Parking Breakdown & Rates
 Pacific Mall features multi-level basement parking capable of housing thousands of vehicles, but weekend rush can cause slowdowns near the entry ramp.
 4-Wheeler Parking: Available in Basement levels (B1, B2, B3). Rates typically start around ₹50–₹70 for the initial hours.
 2-Wheeler Parking: Dedicated parking zones available in the basement.
 Valet Parking: Available near the main ground-floor entrance facing Najafgarh Road if you wish to bypass basement queues during peak hours.
 Best Time to Reach & Insider Tips
 To make the absolute most of your visit, keep these timing strategies in mind:
 Avoid Weekend Evening Rush: Fridays to Sundays between 5:00 PM and 8:30 PM draw massive crowds. Food stall queues can stretch up to 45 minutes long during these hours.
 The Sweet Spot: Plan your visit on weekdays (Monday to Thursday) between 12:00 PM and 3:30 PM . Stalls are fully stocked, skincare representatives have time to consult, and food is served fresh with minimal waiting times.
 Combine Your Trip: Since Pacific Mall is close to other cultural and pop-culture destinations in West/Central Delhi, you can easily pair this trip with other upcoming pop-culture events like Delhi Comic Con or explore Delhi’s best hidden aesthetic cafes nearby.
 Whether you’re stocking up on holy-grail skincare, hunting for K-pop collectables, or diving headfirst into Korean street cuisine, the Korean Festival 2026 at Pacific Mall Tagore Garden promises an unmissable ten days of pure Hallyu culture. Mark your calendar for 13–22 November 2026 and head down early to catch all the best freebies and deals!
